wants.topic: Lesser-Known Origin Stories of Rishis & Vedic Legends (e.g., Rishi Parashar & Satyavati, Sati Anasuya's Test, Ganga Sagar)
wants.evidence: Mystery of the World hit 25.41x vsNormal with Ganga Sagar & Sati, and 17.1x with Satyavati-Parashar origin story.

wants.topic: Full-Length Cinematic Epics in a Single Video (Full Movie Format)
wants.evidence: Rasiya Films achieved 26.23x vsNormal (355k views) on 'Ramayana Full Movie | रामायण की पूरी कहानी एक ही फिल्म में'.

wants.topic: Childlike Devotion & Emotional Bond with Krishna (Folk Characters like Adhaiya, 'God Se Katti')
wants.evidence: Kalia Katha #03 ('सौ साल की कट्टी') achieved 1.5x vsNormal, and Rasiya Films' Adhaiya-Durga/Ram stories got 10x-13x vsNormal.

wants.topic: Timely Festival Vrat Kathas (Dhanteras & Diwali Specific Worship Stories)
wants.evidence: Gyan Adhyatmik Katha gained 6x to 10.5x vsNormal on Dhanteras and Diwali Vrat Kathas within 10-13 days.

wants.topic: Grand Animated Battle/Origin Stories of Major Gods (Ganesh Gajanan creation, Mahishasur Vadh, Kaliya Mardan)
wants.evidence: KATHA SAGAR's Ganesh origin video reached 33.9M views (6.34x vsNormal) and Mahishasur Vadh reached 5.3M views.

gaps: Deeply researched, high-quality 3D/animated accounts of obscure Rishi curses and origins (e.g., Sati-Brahma interaction, Parashar Rishi) that go beyond standard Puranic summaries.
Bingeable long-form continuous movie-style compilations of complete mythological scriptures (e.g., Complete Shiv Puran or Complete Ramayana) with high production value.
saturated: Generic day-by-day Navratri Kathas (e.g., Maa Katyayani / Maa Siddhidatri standard readings) without a unique narrative hook.
Standard audio-only Bhajan/Song releases uploaded on katha storytelling channels.
English-titled videos targeted at Hindi devotional audiences (e.g., 'When Hanuman Ate the Sun' severely underperformed at 0.01x vsNormal).
Generic low-effort moral stories featuring unidentified characters without strong mythological grounding.
